messages:
Jo Chen (CEO): Short follow-up from last all-hands: customers keep asking for a clear one-pager on BYOK, VPC setup, and what audit logs we can provide. Can we get owners and a fast turnaround?

Ava (Security): I can draft the one-pager and a short FAQ. Will need Platform to confirm exact log types and retention tiers, and Legal to sign off on wording.

Diego (Platform): Confirming we can export request traces, delivery events, and config-change metadata. Default retention: 90d for full traces, 365d for metadata. For Private we support contract-extended retention.

Priya (Legal): Ill review FAQ wording for claims about "EU-only" custody and add the necessary DPA language. Note: retention >3 years needs Privacy sign-off.

Liam (Infra): For VPC/private-link: checklist owner here. Will include sample terraform snippet for flow logs and private DNS, and a diagram. ETA: draft checklist in 48h. Snippet: ```hcl
resource "aws_flow_log" "redwood" {
  log_group_name = "/redwood/vpc/flow"
  traffic_type   = "ALL"
}
```

Maya (Customer Success): Can we also add a short FAQ blurb about BYOK rotation impact on live keys? Sales teams want a paragraph they can paste into RFPs.

Ava (Security): Will include BYOK rotation section: recommended rotation workflow, migration path, and how we avoid customer downtime (key aliases + staged switch).

Diego (Platform): Ill produce a short CLI example for audit export to customer buckets and a beta Postman collection. ETA: 3 business days.

Jo Chen (CEO): Great. Please add owners & links to the compliance workspace and ping me if you need any priority escalation. Can we aim to publish the one-pager next Tue?

Ava (Security): Target: publish by 2000000400 (next Tue). Owner: Ava.

Priya (Legal): Ill complete legal review by 2000000600 (Tue afternoon).

ops-bot: Recording and transcript uploaded: https://redwood.internal/recordings/1999999999

Liam (Infra): Noted; opening infra ticket for the VPC checklist components.

Maya (Customer Success): Thanks team  Will notify AE and CS once published.

Diego (Platform): ACK  Ill link the export API docs in the ticket.
